decisions.quote: This preregistered methodological validation study evaluates how well large language models perform title/abstract screening for preclinical systematic reviews from BRISA. We will compare LLM decisions against the reviews’ final full-text inclusion (gold standard), estimating sensitivity/specificity, efficiency gains, and test–retest reproducibility across multiple datasets.

decisions.quote: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) screen titles and abstracts without review-specific training, but generating screening decisions as text takes processing time and incurs API charges. We evaluated Jev, a non-generative model returning classification probabilities, on 4527 records from two systematic reviews of bipolar disorder treatments.
